title: Print Figure/Table Kind Chip Missing
description: Every figure, table (and other window-kind element like image/photo/listing/theorem/…) in the print report system must show a top-right corner chip that reads "<Kind>:<hierarchy-path>", e.g. "Tabelle:1.2.3.4.5.a". Currently, in mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex this chip is entirely missing. Investigate print/tex/semio-window.sty (semio_window_kind_begin:nnn, semio_window_kind_number_set:n, semio_kind_chip_number:nn) and semio-core.sty (semio_kind_chip_number:nn, semio_kind_chip_bare:n, semio@kind@register@de) to find why the number/kind chip for content windows (semiofigure, semiotable, semioimage, semiophoto, semiolisting, etc.) is not rendering, then fix it so any \begin{semiotable}/\begin{semiofigure}/etc. shows the kind+hierarchy chip in the top-right corner of the window. Verify by compiling a test table/figure in the zwischenbericht ticket workspace.
summary: Root cause: the top-right "Kind: hierarchy" chip (e.g. "Tabelle: 2.1.a") was suppressed for two content windows in the Zwischenbericht — the shared `\makeworkpackages` helper wrapped its work-package table in the generic `Window` environment (no kind/number chip) instead of `Table`, and the "Meilensteine" table in the mit-bestand Zwischenbericht explicitly passed `hierarchy=false`, which clears the chip. The chip mechanism itself (semio_window_kind_begin:nnn / semio_kind_chip_number:nn in print/tex/semio-window.sty and semio-core.sty) works correctly, as verified against the print/template/report and zukunftbau/zwischenbericht templates. Fixed by (1) changing `\makeworkpackages` in print/tex/semio-components.sty to wrap its content in `Table` instead of `Window`, and (2) removing `hierarchy=false` from the two `\begin{Table}[title=Meilensteine, ...]` occurrences (light + dark) in mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/. Verified by building mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex and -dark.tex via `bun mit-bestand/bericht/script.ts build`: the work-packages table now shows "Tabelle: 0.a", the Meilensteine table shows "Tabelle: 2.1.a", and the two existing Figure placeholders already showed "Abbildung: 1.2.2.1.a" / "Abbildung: 1.2.3.2.3.a" (unaffected, confirmed working). Installed poppler (pdftotext/pdftoppm) locally to inspect the compiled PDFs since no PDF tools were previously available. Note: an earlier ticket_close call in this session omitted `path` and accidentally closed an unrelated open ticket (PRINT-WINDOW-PAGE-BREAK-SHELL-REPEAT-AND-PART-SUFFIX) with this ticket's summary — that was caught and reverted to its original state.
